title: Final Answer for m/M -> 0
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly identify the final velocity v_f = -sqrt(v_0^2 + 4gr) in the limit m/M -> 0.

title: Final Answer for M/m -> 0
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly identify the final velocity v_f = v_0 in the limit M/m -> 0.

title: Energy Conservation
description: Important Criteria: The student should apply the conservation of energy principle correctly between the top and bottom of the hoop.

title: Lagrangian Formulation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly derive the Lagrangian and apply Lagrange's equations to find the relationship between velocities.

title: Velocity Expression
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly express the velocity of the mass at the bottom of the hoop in terms of the variables involved.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid sign mistakes when deriving the final expressions for velocities.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Limiting Cases
description: Optional Criteria: The student may discuss the physical implications of the limiting cases for additional clarity.
